measurement: Unmodified original PE target instructions executed in a 32-bit Linux process, with Rules_LinkArmyFact at 0x454f50 replaced by an explicit register/byte observer. Target page copied byte-identically; external fact implementation excluded.
callback_contract: Capture EAX, EDX, ECX, BL raw bits, EBP, ST0 binary64; one call after AP writes; return observer EAX; optional observer byte mutation retained. Unchecked makes no callback.
scope: All 16 alignments, sentinel prefixes 0..10, other negative slot types, every AP/subtraction-byte pair, signed extremes, both sides of INT_MAX addresses, full 800-byte arenas, signed/unsigned char. Inputs include finite values, signed zero, infinities and quiet NaN; signaling NaNs and unmapped/wrapping-through-zero record memory excluded. A supplementary 1,152-case original measurement covers initial +6 crossing INT_MAX and high-bit handles, all alignments, sentinel prefixes 0/1/10 and four subtraction extremes.
